verdict.summary: Round 1's major ambiguity is corrected. commitment_digest now includes both holder_count and each holder's commitment count before the corresponding segment, so the previously demonstrated merged-vs-split flattened preimage is structurally distinct without relying on SHA-512 collision resistance. The new commitment_digest_binds_holder_arities regression test is non-vacuous: it first proves the old flattened preimages are identical, then verifies both the corrected digest and derived freshness tag differ. The implementation remains consistent with the scoped feasibility record and retains explicit research-grade/external-audit and semi-honest limitations. No new correctness, soundness, test-validity, security, or instruction-injection issue was found in the changed paths.
